ScanAttempt.description: One attempt against the target — every seed produces exactly one.

error_detail.description: Captured exception text on outcome=error; None otherwise.
error_detail.title: Error Detail

judge_evidence.description: Verdict.evidence flattened to strings (recipients, markers, confidence).
judge_evidence.title: Judge Evidence

pattern_id.description: Payload pattern_id (matches the seed in v0.2).
pattern_id.title: Pattern Id

tool_call_trace.description: Names of tools the target's planner invoked, in order — persisted for EVERY judged attempt (finding and no_finding) so a finding is auditable from the report alone.
tool_call_trace.title: Tool Call Trace

verdict_mechanism.description: How the verdict was decided; None for skip/error outcomes.
verdict_mechanism.title: Verdict Mechanism

verdict_reason.description: Verdict.reason verbatim, or the skip/error explanation.
verdict_reason.title: Verdict Reason

ScanAttempt.title: ScanAttempt

description:
Run-metadata sibling of ExploitRecord; written to scan_report.json.

Phase 1 ships this schema-validated under ``scripts/regenerate_schemas.py``
so CI catches drift and Phase 2 / future CI consumers can validate the
report shape without depending on the Python package.

aborted.description: Non-null if the scan terminated early or ran nothing. Values: 'budget_exceeded' (--max-llm-calls hit), 'provider_unreachable' (consecutive LLM failures), 'describe_failed' (adapter.describe() raised), or 'no_payloads' (no seeds were applicable to the target — the scan did not actually exercise anything).
aborted.title: Aborted

fallback_breakdown.description: Counts of fallback events by cause, e.g. {'judge_unparseable_output': n, 'judge_call_raised': n, 'customiser_fallback': n}.
fallback_breakdown.title: Fallback Breakdown

inconclusive_attempts.description: Number of attempts whose verdict came from an LLM-judge fallback (the call raised, or its output was unparseable) rather than a real judgement. A scan where this equals the judged-attempt count found nothing because it could not judge — not because the target is secure.
inconclusive_attempts.title: Inconclusive Attempts

single_run.description: Phase 1 runs each seed once. Phase 2's 5-run flakiness filter will set this to False when those replays land.
single_run.title: Single Run

title: ScanReport
